messages:
Samir Patel: Heads up — Veridian exec ping. They want updated POC pricing + completed security questionnaire by EOD. CISO flagged two hard blockers: (1) KMS key residency (they insist on customer-managed keys in us-east-1) and (2) SCIM/SSO provisioning + cert rotation policy. Also want subprocessor locations. Can SE + Eng + Legal triage? @Maria Chen @Zach Lowe @Jay Kapoor @Elaine Torres
Maria Chen: On it. I'll pull our securityAnswers doc and do a diff vs their questionnaire. Do we have the latest PDF from their portal or a spreadsheet?
Zach Lowe: KMS note: we support customer-managed keys (CMK) in Private deployments. For Hosted API we offer an enterprise BYOK flow but it requires dedicated infra and an initial setup window. I can lay out specifics. @Samir do we know if they expect BYOK for hosted or are they open to Dedicated/Private for the POC?
Samir Patel: They wrote "bring our keys, no cloud provider keys" — sounds like strict BYOK, wants hosted-level convenience though.
Elaine Torres: Sales context: POC is 6 weeks time-box; exec expects minimal friction. If BYOK forces Dedicated/Private, we need to include migration/setup uplift in pricing. @Erin Diaz can you run a delta on committed costs vs hosted baseline?
Erin Diaz: I'll run numbers. Quick Q: do we have a standard BYOK setup fee or is it case-by-case?
Jay Kapoor: Legal: we can do BYOK with an addendum. Need to confirm key control wording, auditable logs, and indemnities. Also will need SOC2 report excerpts, subprocessor list, and any export/transfer clauses. Samir, please send the Veridian questionnaire PDF.
Maria Chen: Pasting standard snippets to start:
```
KMS: Supported in Private deployments (VPC/on-prem). For Hosted, we provide an enterprise BYOK flow for Dedicated customers; key material import is supported via secure onboarding and is stored encrypted in our KMS layer.
SCIM/SSO: SCIM v2 provisioning supported. SAML 2.0 with cert rotation recommended every 90 days. Audit logs available for provisioning events.
Data residency: Region pinning supported for Dedicated/Private. Hosted routes to nearest region unless pinned via dedicated infra.
```
I'll mark divergence points so Legal can review.
Samir Patel: On call with Veridian at 15:00 PT — need an eng lead for architecture/BYOK questions and legal for contract talk. Can @Zach and @Jay join?
Zach Lowe: :thumbsup: I can join 15:00 PT. I'll prepare a minimal arch diagram + checklist of infra items (network peering, trust bundle, cert rotation, KMS import steps).
Jay Kapoor: I can join but may be ~5–10m late. I'll bring a template addendum and list of required audit artifacts.
Elaine Torres: I'll present pricing scenarios on the call. @Erin please prioritize the delta so we can give a rough number on the spot.
Erin Diaz: Running now. Expect a short spreadsheet in 20–30 mins.
oncall-bot: Reminder: calendar invite created for Veridian POC call — 2026-03-21 15:00 PT. Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/veridian-poc
Maria Chen: Security check — Veridian also asked about embeddings/data residency. I'll add explicit language around inference region pinning and retention windows to the questionnaire responses.
Samir Patel: Post-call action owners: @Maria finalize questionnaire responses, @Zach produce BYOK architecture doc, @Jay draft addendum, @Erin update pricing delta, @Elaine coordinate the follow-up. We'll reconvene after the call for an exec-ready summary.
Zach Lowe: Uploaded quick diagram: https://files.redwood.ai/diag/2267890000-byo-arch.png
Samir Patel: Flagging this as an exec escalation in case legal/sales need higher priority. If anything blocks, escalate to me and @CEO-ops. :triangular_flag_on_post:
